faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes CLK 220 use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the year. From 1997 to 2003 (C208 generation), the CLK 220 used the M111 2.3-litre 4-cylinder petrol engine. From 2002 to 2009 (C209 generation), it switched to the M271 1.8-litre supercharged 4-cylinder petrol engine — a completely different unit. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes CLK 220 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my CLK 220?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the M111 or the M271 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M111 CLK 220 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We service M111 engines to the same standard as our other CLK 220 rebuilds — replacing timing chain, timing gears and gaskets where worn.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M271 CLK 220 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace the timing chain, timing gears and gaskets as standard on every M271 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used CLK 220 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my CLK 220 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a CLK 220 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most CLK 220 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
